strings.canntenrolearly: You cannot enrol yet; enrolment starts on {$a}.
strings.canntenrollate: You cannot enrol any more, since enrolment ended on {$a}.
strings.cohortnonmemberinfo: Only members of cohort '{$a}' can self-enrol.
strings.cohortonly_help: Self enrolment may be restricted to members of a specified cohort only. Note that changing this setting has no effect on existing enrolments.
strings.confirmbulkdeleteenrolment: Are you sure you want to delete these user enrolments?
strings.defaultrole_desc: Select role which should be assigned to users during self enrolment
strings.enrolenddate_help: If enabled, users can enrol themselves until this date only.
strings.enrolenddaterror: Enrolment end date cannot be earlier than start date
strings.enrolkeyrequired: An enrolment key will be required.
strings.enrolperiod_desc: Default length of time that the enrolment is valid. If set to zero, the enrolment duration will be unlimited by default.
strings.enrolperiod_help: Length of time that the enrolment is valid, starting with the moment the user enrols themselves. If disabled, the enrolment duration will be unlimited.
strings.enrolstartdate_help: If enabled, users can enrol themselves from this date onward only.
strings.expiredaction_help: Select action to carry out when user enrolment expires. Please note that some user data and settings are purged from course during course unenrolment.
strings.expiryinactivemessageenrolledbody: Hi {$a->user}, Your enrolment in the course {$a->course} expires on {$a->timeend} as you have not accessed it in the last {$a->inactivetime} days. To keep your enrolment active, log in and access {$a->course} before {$a->timeend}.
strings.expirymessageenrolledbody:
Dear {$a->user},

This is a notification that your enrolment in the course '{$a->course}' is due to expire on {$a->timeend}.

If you need help, please contact {$a->enroller}.
strings.groupkey_desc: Use group enrolment keys by default.
strings.groupkey_help:
In addition to restricting access to the course to only those who know the key, use of group enrolment keys means users are automatically added to groups when they enrol in the course.

Note: An enrolment key for the course must be specified in the self enrolment settings as well as group enrolment keys in the group settings.
strings.keyholder: You should have received this enrolment key from:
strings.longtimenosee_help: If users haven't accessed a course for a long time, then they are automatically unenrolled. This parameter specifies that time limit.
strings.maxenrolled_help: Specifies the maximum number of users that can self enrol. 0 means no limit.
strings.maxenrolledreached: Maximum number of users allowed to self-enrol was already reached.
strings.newenrols_desc: Allow users to self enrol into new courses by default.
strings.newenrols_help: This setting determines whether a user can enrol into this course.
strings.password_help:
An enrolment key enables access to the course to be restricted to only those who know the key.

If the field is left blank, any user may enrol in the course.

If an enrolment key is specified, any user attempting to enrol in the course will be required to supply the key. Note that a user only needs to supply the enrolment key ONCE, when they enrol in the course.
strings.passwordinvalid: Incorrect enrolment key, please try again
strings.passwordinvalidhint:
That enrolment key was incorrect, please try again
(Here's a hint - it starts with '{$a}')
strings.passwordmatchesgroupkey: This enrolment key is already used as a group enrolment key.
strings.pluginname_desc: The self enrolment plugin allows users to choose which courses they want to participate in. The courses may be protected by an enrolment key. Internally the enrolment is done via the manual enrolment plugin which has to be enabled in the same course.
strings.privacy:metadata: The Self enrolment plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.requirepassword_desc: Require enrolment key in new courses and prevent removing of enrolment key from existing courses.
strings.self:holdkey: Appear as the self enrolment key holder
strings.sendcoursewelcomemessage_help: When a user self enrols in the course, they may be sent a welcome message email. If sent from the course contact (by default the teacher), and more than one user has this role, the email is sent from the first user to be assigned the role.
strings.sendexpirynotificationstask: Self enrolment send expiry notifications task
strings.showhint_desc: Show first letter of the guest access key.
strings.status_desc: Enable self enrolment method in new courses.
strings.status_help: If set to No, any existing participants who enrolled themselves into the course will no longer have access.
strings.unenrolselfconfirm: Do you really want to unenrol yourself from course "{$a}"?
strings.unenroluser: Do you really want to unenrol "{$a->user}" from course "{$a->course}"?
strings.usepasswordpolicy_desc: Use standard password policy for enrolment keys.
